The Children and Families Department takes a strengths-based approach to working with each other, children, young people and families, and our partner agencies. We call this 'Our Nottinghamshire Approach'. Watch the two minute animation to learn more.

Nottinghamshire County Council
is dedicated to creating a supportive and inclusive environment for children and young people with Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND). We are committed to ensuring that every child has access to high-quality education and care, empowering them to thrive in their communities.

Are you passionate about making a difference in the lives of children and young people with SEND? As the Place Planning Officer (SEND)
, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring that Nottinghamshire has sufficient high-quality SEND education and childcare places for children and young people aged 0-25. You will support the development and delivery of our SEND Place Planning Strategy through insightful analysis of demographic trends and pupil projections.

In This Exciting Role, Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

Forecasting Future Demand: Anticipate the need for SEND places based on demographic data and trends.
Data Management: Manage and analyse complex data to inform strategic decisions.
Collaboration: Work closely with schools, local authorities, planners, and housing developers to ensure SEND needs are integrated into infrastructure planning.
Expert Advice: Provide guidance to senior leaders and elected members on SEND matters.
Funding Support: Assist in securing funding for additional SEND provisions.
New School Establishment: Support the establishment of new SEND schools to meet local needs.

To Succeed In This Role, You Will Need

A degree or equivalent qualification in SEND, Education, Social Care, or a related field.
In-depth knowledge of SEND legislation and statutory processes.
Experience in managing complex data and contributing to strategic planning.
A strong understanding of safeguarding frameworks and quality assurance methodologies.

We Are Looking For Candidates Who Demonstrate

Leadership: Ability to influence and inspire others in a collaborative environment.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written skills to engage diverse audiences.
Analytical Thinking: Strong problem-solving skills, particularly in data-driven decision-making.
Resilience: A commitment to service excellence and personal accountability.

At Nottinghamshire County Council, we believe in creating a workplace where everyone feels valued. Our benefits include:

A Place to Belong: Join a friendly, inclusive workplace where your contributions matter.
Professional Development: Opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement.
Work-Life Balance: Flexible working arrangements to support your lifestyle.
Generous Leave: Enjoy a healthy work-life balance with ample leave options.

Don’t miss out on this incredible opportunity to make a real difference in your community! If you are ready to take on this rewarding challenge and help shape the future for children and young people with SEND, apply today!

on 01158043906

Description -

The PWI Hardware Planning Analyst ensures that press hardware, compute systems, upgrades, and third-party components are available to support worldwide manufacturing, customer installations, and installed-base commitments. The role translates demand and program schedules into executable supply plans, while coordinating across procurement, manufacturing, inventory control, logistics, engineering, program management, regional operations, sales, and services.

This position operates in a dynamic, low-volume, high-value environment with long lead times and deal-driven demand. Success requires strong planning fundamentals, disciplined execution, sound judgment under uncertainty, and the ability to move confidently between detailed transactional work and executive-level business discussions.

Responsibilities

Demand and supply planning: Balance forecasted and actual demand against supply; identify shortages, excess, aging inventory, and material risks; prioritize backlog and constrained supply; and escalate issues with recommended actions.
Hardware availability and installation readiness: Align press, compute, upgrade, and third-party hardware availability with build and installation schedules. Coordinate schedule changes, customer requirements, and recovery plans with key stakeholders.
Order and procurement execution: Create, manage, and monitor planned orders, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, work orders, and subcontract purchase orders. Track supplier commitments, lead times, and material availability through execution.
Inventory management and control: Monitor inventory value, location, ownership, aging, and excess. Support inventory targets, cycle counts, discrepancy resolution, categorization, rebalancing, and disposition decisions.
Cross-functional coordination: Serve as the planning focal point across procurement, manufacturing, inventory control, logistics, engineering, program management, regional operations, sales, and services. Drive clear decisions, ownership, and follow-through.
Data analysis and reporting: Analyze forecasts, backlog, shortages, inventory, schedule changes, and planning KPIs. Convert data into concise operational and management-level insights and recommendations.
Product and BOM change management: Monitor product configuration, material master, and BOM changes that affect supply, builds, ordering, or installation readiness. Maintain traceability and ensure planning signals reflect the current configuration.
Process improvement and knowledge transfer: Simplify and automate manual workflows, improve data quality and controls, document standard work, and develop reusable training and reporting tools.

Required Skills

Strong supply chain fundamentals, including MRP, supply-demand balancing, lead-time management, safety stock, inventory control, forecasting, and backlog prioritization.
Ability to manage competing priorities and make data-supported decisions with incomplete or changing information.

SAP S/4HANA

Working competence in material, inventory, demand, supply, and order execution. Ability to review supply-demand status and create or manage planning and procurement documents.

Advanced capability in data analysis, reconciliation, reporting, repeatable transformations, and decision support.

Competence in team collaboration, controlled documentation, training content, workflow support, and shared reporting.

Location: Remote (USA)

Job Description:

Geospatial Analyst MAP will design and optimize advanced geospatial data solutions using Databricks, Oracle database, and SQL
The role involves developing robust spatial analytics pipelines, ensuring data accuracy across complex datasets, and delivering actionable insights that guide business decisions.
The analyst will collaborate with cross functional teams to transform location-based data into strategic value for the organization and broader communities.

Responsibilities:

-Design and maintain scalable geospatial data pipelines in Databricks that integrate diverse spatial and non spatial datasets to support analytics initiatives and operational reporting.
-Develop optimized SQL queries and spatial procedures in Oracle database environments to ensure accurate retrieval, transformation, and aggregation of complex geospatial information.
-Analyze large volumes of map centric data to uncover spatial trends patterns and correlations that directly inform strategic planning and resource allocation for the organization.
-Create clear and precise geospatial visualizations and map based dashboards that help stakeholders quickly understand location based insights and make informed decisions.
-Collaborate with data engineers data scientists and business analysts to define data models for geospatial assets ensuring compatibility with existing enterprise database standards.
-Implement rigorous data quality checks and validation rules for geospatial layers and reference datasets to maintain high confidence in analytical outputs used by internal and external partners.
-Document geospatial data dictionaries processing logic and analytical methodologies so that teams can reliably reuse workflows and maintain continuity in long term projects.
-Provide expert guidance on geospatial data governance including coordinate reference systems metadata conventions and data retention practices to align with company policies.
-Evaluate new tools libraries and techniques for geospatial analysis in Databricks and related ecosystems to continuously improve performance scalability and feature depth of solutions.
-Coordinate with infrastructure and platform teams to tune Databricks clusters and Oracle database configurations so geospatial workloads run efficiently under varying data volumes.
-Support business teams by translating complex geospatial findings into concise recommendations that highlight operational efficiencies risk reduction opportunities and customer experience improvements.
-Contribute to the company purpose by using location intelligence to enhance service accessibility optimize environmental impact and support responsible growth in the communities served.
-Mentor junior analysts on best practices in geospatial analysis SQL coding standards and database design principles helping build a strong internal capability in spatial analytics.

Qualifications:

-Possess extensive experience working with Databricks including building notebooks managing jobs and optimizing cluster usage for heavy geospatial data processing workloads.
-Hold deep expertise in Oracle database administration and development with proven ability to design tables indexes and spatial extensions that support complex analytic queries.
-Demonstrate strong proficiency in SQL covering query optimization window functions and spatial query constructs to efficiently handle large relational datasets.
-Bring solid knowledge of general database concepts such as normalization transaction management and performance tuning to maintain reliable and high performing data systems.
-Exhibit practical understanding of geospatial concepts including projections topology and spatial joins enabling accurate integration and analysis of diverse location based sources.
-Display comfort working standard day shifts with flexibility to coordinate across regions when necessary while maintaining consistent delivery on project milestones.
-Apply analytical and problem solving skills gained from at least ten years of professional experience to design robust solutions and troubleshoot complex data challenges.
-Prefer prior exposure to enterprise scale data platforms and cloud based analytics environments which strengthens ability to integrate geospatial workloads with broader data ecosystems.
